messages:
maya (marketing): Hey @sam — we need final bench samples + packaging for the launch campaign. Goal: compare hosted vs dedicated vs quantized variants, two payload types (short chat, long completion). Deadline EOD Wed. Can you run sanity reruns and drop CSVs + artifacts? :pray:
sam (runtime): Got it. Quick clarifying q's: which exact model names and quant levels? seq lengths? concurrency matrix? Also do you want raw logs or just summary CSVs?
maya (marketing): Models: gpt-neox-20b-fp16, gpt-neox-20b-8bit, redwood-7b-quant. Seq lengths: 16 and 1024. Concurrency points: 1, 8, 32. Short payload ~20 tokens, long ~800 tokens. Include both streaming and non-streaming if possible.
ana (analytics typo correction)
ana (analytics): (meant ana) For ingestion format please use CSV with columns: model, variant, seq_len, concurrency, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, mem_gb, error_rate, runs, stddev_p95. Filename prefix: marketing-campaign-v1-<model>-<variant>.csv
sam (runtime): Perfect — I'll include raw logs + a runner-config.json for each sweep. Using dedicated-pool-2 for high-concurrency runs. Note: 8bit may OOM at seq=1024 depending on batch size; plan: try batch_size=1 then microbatching.
julian (product): Also include latency percentiles broken out by sampling params (temp/topk) — we care about tail latency for the interactive demo.
tom (marketing): Can we get one sanitized sample output per model/variant to vet messaging? Please strip PII and anything hallucinated about real people.
sam (runtime): Will add sanitized-samples/ to the artifact bundle. Reproducibility defaults I'll use: seed=42, sampler=topk(50), temp=0.7. Artifacts will land in the shared drive: https://drive.redu/redwood-marketing-bench (placeholder link).
maya (marketing): One more ask — run each config 3 times and include stddev for p95. If variance > 10% flag it and call out likely causes.
sam (runtime): Understood. ETA: smoke runs by tomorrow morning, full sweep by Wed EOD. I'll post CSV links + short summary here when done.
ana (analytics): Also include per-request token_in/token_out counts and request size so we can do cost calc and route-level cost breakdown.
sam (runtime): Added token_in/token_out columns. CSV will include: tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_est_usd (est).
maya (marketing): If you hit capacity/timeouts, fallback plan: run a representative 1/3 subset (all models x low/high seq x concurrency 1/8) and annotate missing configs.
sam (runtime): Acknowledged. Starting runs now. Will capture env: run_id, runner_version, pool, GPU type. :rocket:
deploy-bot: build 2026.02.11-rc3: bench-runner started on dedicated-pool-2
julian (product): Huge thanks — this data will let us lock the blog graphs and webinar demo scripts.
tom (marketing): ping @sam next week if you need marketing creds or any sanitized corpus for the sample outputs.
sam (runtime): No external creds needed. I'll update this thread with: artifact link, summary CSVs, a short README, and the runner config + exact commands used. Example command I'm running:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/bench -d @payload.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
maya (marketing): Awesome — thanks so much. Please mention any known caveats (e.g., 8bit memory edge cases) in the README. :thumbsup:
